candidate_reports.remark: Report of swift-water rescue on Shoal Creek. An unhoused woman went in at approximately West 5th St Bridge and was rescued from trees downstream.
Vehicle stuck in a low water crossing in Del Rio on Mary Lou Drive at Kings Way.
Public reported 6.01 inches of rain had fallen over the area impacting the property.
Emergency manager relayed several ranch road low water crossings in the Barksdale area were flooding_ and some were impassable.
Flooding on roadways_ especially low water crossings_ from nearby creeks and draws across northwest and western Edwards County. This includes State Highway 55 and US highway 377.

Texas Parks and Wildlife Emergency Manager reported and provided picture of flooding across Dolan Creek Road that is barricaded and closed to traffic. Devils River State Natural Area - Del Norte has been closed until Monday with no visitors on site.
Texas Park and Wildlife emergency manager reported that Kickapoo Cavern State Park will be closed until Monday due to flooding in the surrounding region. Any campers will shelter in place.
Water rescue was conducted within this proximity region of the county along CR 450 associated with a creek within the Newby Hills subdivision/ranch.

EM report of water over area roadways in Edwards County including Highway 377 and RR 674 following prolonged steady rain. Some locations with 2.5 ft of water and extensive ponding along shoulders. Location is approximate.
